sync.pendingCount: {{count}} changes waiting to upload from this device
sync.recordStates: Saved: on this device. Synced: on the farm server. Waiting: will upload when you're back online.
sync.quarantinedCount: {{count}} records refused by the server; review them before re-exporting.

farm.selectPrompt: Choose which farm you're working on; data and tasks follow the selected farm.

feed.targetMode: A record applies to either one animal or one location — not both.
feed.scheduleTime: Time of day this feeding runs, e.g. 07:00. Tasks are generated for this time.
feed.scheduleInactive: Turns off this schedule; no more feeding tasks will be generated from it.
feed.rationShare: Share of the total ration. Shares must add up to 100%.
feed.share: This feed type's share of total feed cost for the period. Shares add up to 100%.

animal.parentTerms: sire = the father, dam = the mother of this animal.
animal.weightStatus: Due: next check coming up. Overdue: past the due date — weigh as soon as you can.

breeding.dueWindow: Days until the expected due date. The colour flags how urgent it is: warmer means due soon or overdue.
breeding.birthOutcome: Alive: living at birth. Stillborn: no signs of life. Weak: alive but needs extra care.

hr.checkInOut: Check in starts the shift, check out ends it. Times come from this device's clock.

health.batch: batch = the manufacturer's lot number, shown on the packaging.
health.expiryStatus: Red: already expired. Orange: expires within 30 days. Do not use expired stock.
health.lowStockThreshold: Alert level: a low-stock warning appears when stock falls to this amount.
health.defaultDosage: Dosage filled in on a vaccination record that uses this vaccine. You can change it per animal.
health.linkedMedicine: The medicine stock this vaccine draws from, so recording a dose reduces that medicine's remaining quantity.
health.recurrenceDays: Days between doses in this schedule. The next due date is the last dose plus this interval.

report.margin: margin = revenue minus costs for this row.
report.animalDays: animal-days = one animal counted for one day; total days animals were kept.

member.role: What this member can open and change. SystemOwner has full access; Viewer can only read.
member.revokeEffect: Removes their access immediately; their records stay with the farm.

admin.cron: Schedule expression: 0 3 * * * means daily at 03:00. Five fields, minute, hour, day, month, weekday.
admin.auditAction: The operation that was recorded, such as Create, Update or Delete, for the entity in the same row.

nav.openMenu: Open the navigation menu to jump to another section of the farm.

inventory.movementType: Purchase adds stock, Consumption removes it, Adjustment corrects a count, Transfer moves stock between locations.
inventory.signedQuantity: Signed change in stock: positive increases it, negative decreases it. Adjustments carry their own sign.
inventory.reorderLevel: Stock level that should trigger a new purchase. The low-stock warning uses this number.
inventory.stockValue: Quantity on hand times unit cost — the money the stock is worth right now.

finance.category: Category groups this entry for the reports. It does not change the amount.
finance.account: The bank or credit account the money went through. It is not a cost category.

config.parentLocation: The location this one sits inside. Animals in the child are also counted in the parent.
